releases.title: Gated catalog product expansion
releases.summary: Added three catalog products to the existing fail-closed commercial rail while preserving manual activation and delivery prerequisites.
highlights: Added Claims Guard, Agentic Business OS, and Vibe OS entries to the product catalog.
Extended the setup checklist and product mapping while keeping checkout gates closed by default.
limitations: The products remain gated until packaged files, merchant products, delivery configuration, and owner approval are complete.

releases.title: CI and web release gates
releases.summary: Strengthened continuous-integration coverage and installed the repository web-excellence contract for future public-interface changes.
highlights: Adjusted the merge gate so draft pull requests receive current repository validation.
Installed the mechanical web-excellence gate and session contracts for UI work.
limitations: Mechanical checks do not replace desktop, mobile, reduced-motion, accessibility, or human visual review.

releases.title: Checkout and source-truth hardening
releases.summary: Added a fail-closed Polar checkout path and corrected public installation guidance to point to executable open-source artifacts.
highlights: Added an API checkout route beside the existing URL path with catalog, mapping, and credential gates.
Replaced private or non-executable install references with the public Agentic Income skills repository and tested commands.
limitations: A sandbox purchase and current production verification are still required before any checkout capability is presented as active.

releases.title: Control-plane and education hub
releases.summary: Established the education-first Agentic Income hub, portable pack guidance, and browser-local delivery reference surfaces.
highlights: Added the knowledge base, portable Income Architect pack, and structured product paths.
Added Build, Operate, Proof, and browser-local request-to-quote reference routes with explicit authority lanes.
limitations: The request-to-quote desk is browser-local and does not send customer data, issue contracts, or move money.

releases.title: Implementation engine and trust desk
releases.summary: Repositioned the product around scoped implementation and added an inspectable trust comparison surface with honest access states.
highlights: Organized the experience around Audit, Architect, Implement, and Verify with repository-backed proof.
Added comparison criteria, disclosure, freshness, ownership, and paid or unpaid route states before click-through.
limitations: The historical release evidence left final production promotion and some visual acceptance decisions human-gated.

releases.title: Visual and audit portability
releases.summary: Added branded visual assets and made repository audit execution more portable across supported Node environments.
highlights: Added the initial GitHub and infographic visual asset suite.
Updated audit execution to use the active Node runtime instead of an environment-specific binary assumption.
limitations: Asset presence alone is not current proof of production placement, licensing review, or responsive visual quality.

releases.title: Foundation accessibility and CI
releases.summary: Established the repository CI baseline and improved form accessibility, licensing, and audit-script portability.
highlights: Added the initial GitHub Actions continuous-integration workflow.
Improved email-input accessibility and guarded affiliate-audit script execution across environments.
limitations: This baseline record does not certify current production accessibility or end-to-end email retention.
